cues.zh: 這裡就標出1和2的臨界位置。

cues.en: And it's interesting to see which functions have the critical values here.
cues.zh: 看看哪些函數在這些位置有臨界點，很有意思。

cues.en: So it looks like it's this purple line.
cues.zh: 看起來是這條紫色線。

cues.en: You can see the the bend in the function.
cues.zh: 可以看到函數的轉彎處。

cues.en: It changes its mind and starts going the other way at exactly X equals one.
cues.zh: 正好在x等於1改變心意，往另一個方向。

cues.en: These other functions here, they have their critical points, less than one here.
cues.zh: 其他這些函數，臨界點在1以下。

cues.en: The critical points are greater than one here.
cues.zh: 這裡的臨界點大於1。

cues.en: The critical point is exactly two.
cues.zh: 這個臨界點剛好是2。

cues.en: And it's a little bit harder to see here.
cues.zh: 這邊比較難看出來。

cues.en: But essentially you're looking for this line going through zero and you see that all of these functions
cues.zh: 基本上，要找這條線通過0，可以看到所有這些函數，

cues.en: go through zero, but it's only the orange line and the purple line that cross zero at exactly X equals one and exactly X equals two.
cues.zh: 都通過0，但只有橘線和紫線，正好在x等於1和2通過0。

cues.en: Very nice.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: I hope you enjoyed this.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡這段，

cues.zh: 待會見。
